notes: Sound effects and music. Paths are relative to this file. No sound-effect files exist yet, so that list is empty.

sounds: one entry per cue. Each lists alternative files of the same sound; the first format the browser can play is used. A cue with no entry plays a synthesized stand-in (set audio.standIn to false in dungeon.json to turn those off).

Cues: jump, land, swing, shoot, cast, heal, hit, hurt, defeat, coin, pickup, key, chest, break, lever, gate, locked, checkpoint, shrine, teleport, fall, respawn, alert, growl, boss, phase, shockwave, breath, complete, gameover, ui.
music: tracks by moment. 'title' plays on the menus; 'level' in any level, or 'level:<tileset id>' for one theme; 'boss' during a boss fight; 'complete' on the results screen.

A music entry is either one recording ('files': the same track in alternative formats, the first the browser can play is used) or a 'playlist' of MIDI files played one after another by the game's built-in piano voice. 'order' is 'shuffle' or 'listed'. A playlist of one piece repeats it.
Today: the slow pieces in assets/music/slow play in every level, and the fast piece in assets/music/fast plays during a boss fight. The menus and the results screen have no music.
